mode.description: "new" drafts from the prompt; "redraft" fixes a failed test against currentDraft.

prompt.description: The user's free-text description of what to schedule and how often. Treat as the spec.

actionCatalog.description: The full action catalog, same shape meta.orchestrate receives — used to check whether an existing action already covers the request.

currentDraft.description: Redraft mode only — the previous proposal.

testError.description: Redraft mode only — the script's real stdout/stderr from the user's Test click on currentDraft.

scheduleEditSessionId.description: Pass through verbatim to mcp__outpost__submit_schedule_proposal — matches the proposal back to the waiting editor.

proposalRoute.description: Informational — confirms where the daemon expects the proposal. Not called directly; the submit tool handles delivery.
